- Artifact Families Introduced: A-1155, A-1156, A-1157, A-1158, A-1159, A-1160, A-1161, A-2519

Episode presses two investigative threads. First, FBI pressure on Utah authorities to declare the Charlie Kirk case closed as a lone-gunman act despite host's sources reporting no roof footage, no matching bullet, and an eyewitness disputing Tyler Robinson's outfit. Second, a freshly scraped 80-page online-history document on Thomas Matthew Crooks is presented as evidence he should have been on federal radar. Host shows on-screen text messages (Aug 30–Sep 2) about a premonition of imminent school-related danger using 'bees' as code, then links this to Utah's beehive flag and Soviet educational ideology. Reads Megyn Kelly segment on a Jezebel/Etsy hex against Charlie Kirk and plays the Jimmy Kimmel free-speech monologue clip.
